description: Extrapolate COVIDx CXR-2 test accuracy to the official 500-shot transfer scale for each released pretraining setup.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: Source-reported mean test accuracy; larger values represent better performance.

measurement_provenance.method: exact released metric_value entries; duplicate resume reports removed with the official notebook key and five official seeds averaged
measurement_provenance.excluded_scale: full_shot is excluded because it is a dataset-dependent label rather than a shared numeric shot count
measurement_provenance.seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean; seed standard deviation retained
